sceneNote: The take was recorded without a scene and its points aim about 20° up, into sky in an open scene; the room scene puts a wall in their path so each point yields a link. What they hit is not scored.
source: Written 2026-10-22 from the replay's 0.2 s contact sheets (spectator view, tracked-joint dots) before any detector existed, cross-read against per-finger extension and thumb-index distance computed from the recorded tracked joints at 0.2 s steps. Boundaries are good to about 0.2 s; wave/reach boundary about 0.4 s.
useFor: timing and silence only; this was recorded in a real room, so what a point's ray hits in the replay scene says nothing about the referent
timeBase: seconds from the first input frame; the capture recording starts within two 30 Hz steps of it

segments.name: fist
segments.note: both hands closed, all fingers curled

segments.name: point-right
segments.note: index extended, middle/ring/pinky curled; both hands point together

segments.name: open-between
segments.note: hands open again between point and pinch

segments.name: pinch
segments.note: thumb and index touching (about 1 cm), other fingers extended

segments.name: wave
segments.note: open hands rocking side to side

segments.name: reach
segments.note: open hands moving toward the viewer
